name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits introducing Connect Knowledge (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox integration), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, and a Telegram remote-control gateway. It also adds PBKDF2 password hashing with rate-limiting, clean-path routing replacing hash routes, and a redesigned 'Manila Arc' UI. v0.6.0 adds a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04, v0.6.0 adds self-updater
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update channel; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases instead of the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet, but requires more setup and heavier resource usage.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more enterprise-oriented document management system with workflow support, but is heavier and more complex to administer than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a much broader ecosystem including file management, but is significantly heavier and more complex than Cabinet's focused lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and classification, but demands more infrastructure and configuration compared to Cabinet's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focuses on file browsing across multiple backends, but lacks the document-centric management and metadata features of Cabinet.
